intent: Assemble the transcripts present in this single-end RNA-seq alignment (sample.bam, produced by STAR with default output options) with StringTie, without a reference annotation. The library is strand-specific, made with the dUTP protocol (fr-firststrand, reads come from the strand opposite to the transcript).
silent_error: Without --rf/--fr StringTie treats the library as unstranded and takes the strand of spliced reads from the XS attribute. STAR (without --outSAMstrandField intronMotif) writes no XS tag, and StringTie then simply ignores those spliced reads: the intron-spanning reads that join exons are discarded and the exons come out as strandless ('.') single-exon fragments: the two exons of the first gene as two separate transcripts, only the first exon of the second gene, and nothing at all for the third gene (3 single-exon transcripts, 3 exons), instead of the 3 spliced two-exon transcripts on strands +, -, + obtained with --rf (6 exons). StringTie exits 0, prints nothing, and the GTF looks valid. StringTie documents --rf as 'assume a stranded library fr-firststrand'.
